reason: The raw positive association (1.78) disappears once the pre-period confounders (firm size, firm age) are controlled, and it stays null (about 0.05, p=0.84) when I add every pre-period covariate, region, sector and listing status. The analyst rightly left out the post-treatment buyer_rating_2023, which flips the sign if included. The conclusion should be worded as 'no detectable effect', since the CI is not tight, but it is supported.
